db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb:22 - Migrated hosts are not normalized or escaped, so existing embeds break, and the old settings are deleted anyway.. The old `embeddable_hosts` setting allowed entries like `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234`; the old specs used exactly these. The migration inserts each line raw. It skips the model's scheme and path stripping and does not remove whitespace or `\r`. `record_for_host` compares `uri.host` with `lower(host)`, so those rows never match, and embedding stops working for those sites. A value containing `'` also breaks the SQL statement. Line 31 then deletes the original settings in a `change` migration with no `down`, so the data cannot be recovered. Strip the scheme, path and whitespace, skip blank lines, quote values with `ActiveRecord::Base.connection.quote`, and make the delete reversible or keep the old setting values.
